chunks: And We strengthened their hearts when they stood up and said: 'Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We shall invoke no god beside Him, for we shall have uttered a blasphemy then.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the people whose hearts were strengthened in Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual fortitude granted to the disciples (Hawariyyun) of Prophet Jesus (AS), enabling them to steadfastly proclaim monotheism after a period of concealment. Their declaration serves as a paradigm for the faithful, emphasizing that true conviction requires both internal strengthening by God and public affirmation of His lordship over all creation. This moment underscores the transition from private belief to public testimony, a key concept in understanding the status of the Hawariyyun as the elite supporters of the Prophet.
